text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Almond Eye—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Almond Eye pointed,
there was a crane game filled with
plushies modeled after Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Hm? Do you wanna do it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Umm, just a few.
I was just thinking Kyumaru's plushie could use
a few more friends.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Wait for a bit, I'll catch one right away!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I see. So at this angle, that's what happens.
...I understand now. This time for sure!
choice_data_list: Hold on, tag me in! Just watch for a second!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to just watch over her if I could, but...
I couldn't overlook her exchanging money a second time.
—At this rate, her wallet was in serious danger."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's true, stepping back for a better look
might help me get the hang of it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
